syllabus_topics: Basic principles of heat supply for industry and residential areas
Basic energy (electrical energy and heat) generating sources and their utilisation
Heat supply systems and heat exchanger stations, advantages and disadvantages
Heat supply in industry - an introduction
Cogeneration versus separate generation of heat and electricity - basic principles, effectivity, primary energy utilisation
Energy consumption balance diagrams and their utilisation
Heating plants, boiler construction for heating plants
Power and heating plants (Rankin cycle), boiler construction/turbine construction for power and heating plants
Power and heating plants (Ericsson/Brayton cycle), gas turbines, gas combustion engines
Heat supply distribution lines, heat supply - steam or hot water lines - advantages/disadvantages
Pressure distribution diagram for hot water heat supply systems
Basic design of the pipelines - diameter and wall thickness
Heat loss calculation for heat supply lines/pipes
Thermal expansion - pipeline, pipeline support and its design, thermal expansion sleeves - basic types
Heat Exchange Stations - basic principles and configuration
Power and heating plants and distribution lines - heat supply and energy supply control
Energy and heat supply - the future, perspectives and development

Obara S.: Distributed Energy Systems. Nova Science Publishers, Incorporated, 2009
